name: Source File Dropzone
description: A document dropzone with local file selection, type and size validation, duplicate handling and a removable file list for knowledge and upload flows.

props.name: files
props.description: Controlled local File objects. Without onChange, selection and removal are read-only. Uploading and persistence remain the host responsibility.

props.name: defaultFiles
props.description: Initial uncontrolled files. The component copies the array while retaining the File objects.

props.name: accept
props.description: Comma-separated extensions or MIME types, including image/* style wildcards. Client-side convenience; validate again on your server.

props.name: maxBytes
props.description: Maximum bytes per file; finite values are clamped to zero or above. File sizes and limits use readable B, KB or MB units.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables selecting, dropping and removing files.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous notification containing a separate array of the full next selection, with the original File objects. The host acknowledges controlled changes and owns uploading.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
